mapper.select: SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, h.hobby_nm, h.summary, dc.code_nm AS difficulty_nm FROM t_hobby h LEFT JOIN t_code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND (h.hobby_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR h.summary LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY h.sort_no, h.hobby_id LIMIT 10

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.title, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (r.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR r.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC LIMIT 10

WITH hit AS ( SELECT b.bbs_id, b.bbsinfo_id, b.title, b.reg_id, b.reg_dt,
regexp_replace(COALESCE(b.context, ''), '<[^>]*>', ' ', 'g') AS plain, (b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\') AS title_hit FROM t_bbs b WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_bbs_id = 0 AND b.secret_yn = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_hobby h WHERE h.bbsinfo_id = b.bbsinfo_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y') ) SELECT hit.bbs_id::TEXT AS row_id, hit.bbsinfo_id, hit.title, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = hit.reg_id) AS reg_nm, bi.bbsinfo_nm, TO_CHAR(hit.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt, -- 본문에서 찾았을 때만 스니펫: 매칭 지점 앞 20자부터 100자를 잘라 문맥을 보여준다 CASE WHEN NOT hit.title_hit AND POSITION(#{keyword} IN hit.plain) > 0 THEN BTRIM(SUBSTRING(hit.plain FROM GREATEST(1, POSITION(#{keyword} IN hit.plain) - 20) FOR 100)) END AS search_snippet FROM hit LEFT JOIN t_bbsinfo bi ON bi.bbsinfo_id = hit.bbsinfo_id WHERE hit.title_hit OR hit.plain LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' -- 제목에서 찾은 글을 본문에서만 찾은 글보다 앞에(간단한 관련도 정렬) ORDER BY hit.title_hit DESC, hit.bbs_id DESC LIMIT 10
